Key Features & Advantages

Controlled Geared Motion

Geared chain drive prevents unintentional coasting and allows exact load spotting.

Anti-Drop Structural Lugs

Side plates include safety lugs to maintain beam connection in all conditions.

High Gear Efficiency

Precision cut cast gears require minimal hand chain pull effort.

Standards & Compliance

EN 13157

Overhead lifting trolley standard.

CE Certified

150% proof load tested.

Product Overview

The Europull EPGT geared trolley provides controlled positioning of heavy machinery. By pulling the hand chain, the operator glides the suspended hoist along the beam with absolute accuracy.

Frequently Asked Questions

Which models of the Europull Manual Gear Trolley are available?

The Europull Manual Gear Trolley is available in 7 models: EPGT-005, EPGT-010, EPGT-020, EPGT-030, EPGT-050, EPGT-100, EPGT-200. Capacity (Tons) ranges from 0.5 Ton (500 kg) to 20.0 Ton (20,000 kg). Full figures for every model are in the technical specifications table on this page.

What capacity range does the Europull Manual Gear Trolley cover?

The Europull Manual Gear Trolley covers 0.5t - 20t.

Which standard does the Europull Manual Gear Trolley comply with?

The Europull Manual Gear Trolley is manufactured to EN 13157.

What drive Mechanism does the Europull Manual Gear Trolley have?

The Europull Manual Gear Trolley's drive Mechanism: Hand Chain Driven Geared Pinion Drive.

What flange Width Range does the Europull Manual Gear Trolley have?

The Europull Manual Gear Trolley's flange Width Range: 64 mm to 305 mm (Adjustable with Spacers).

What hand Chain does the Europull Manual Gear Trolley have?

The Europull Manual Gear Trolley's hand Chain: Galvanized High Tensile Hand Chain (3m Standard).

How do I request a quotation for the Europull Manual Gear Trolley?
